title: When Is a Game a Markov Decision Process? Correspondences Between Game Theory and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning and game theory describe the same object from two sides. Game theory says what a rational outcome of a strategic interaction is; reinforcement learning says how an agent could reach one through experience. The two literatures nevertheless keep separate vocabularies for identical structures, and the treatments that bridge them present the correspondence as analogy rather than theorem. This monograph supplies the theorems. A game is a Markov decision process in three distinct senses, and every table entry is labelled with the one that applies: a definitional identity, an exact reduction carried by a value- and solution-preserving map, or a structural analogy that fails under identifiable conditions. We take every standard class of game, from normal-form through repeated, stochastic, partially observable, extensive-form with imperfect information, Bayesian, graphical, Stackelberg, potential, coalitional, mean-field

translated_title: 何时博弈是马尔可夫决策过程？博弈论与强化学习之间的对应关系
translated_abstract: 强化学习与博弈论从两个侧面描述同一对象：博弈论说明策略性互动的理性结果是什么，强化学习说明智能体如何通过经验达到这样的结果。然而，这两类文献对相同的结构使用了各自独立的术语体系，而连接两者的现有工作也大多将这种对应关系呈现为类比而非定理。本专著补齐了这些定理。博弈在三种不同的意义上是马尔可夫决策过程，且每个表格条目都标注了所适用的意义：定义性恒等、由保持价值与解的映射所实现的精确约化，或在可识别条件下失效的结构性类比。我们覆盖了每一种标准博弈类别，从标准型博弈，到重复博弈、随机博弈、部分可观测博弈、具有不完美信息的扩展型博弈、贝叶斯博弈、图博弈、斯塔克尔伯格博弈、势博弈、联盟博弈、平均场博弈等。
tldr: 本专著以定理形式系统建立了博弈论与强化学习的对应关系，证明博弈在三种意义上是马尔可夫决策过程——定义性恒等、保持价值与解的精确约化、以及在可识别条件下失效的结构性类比。
en_tdlr: This monograph formalizes the correspondence between game theory and reinforcement learning through theorems, showing that a game is a Markov decision process in three distinct senses: definitional identity, exact value- and solution-preserving reduction, or structural analogy that fails under identifiable conditions.
